stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast cheap Gemini 4 model, and makes it Search's default

key_facts.fact: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on November 12, 2026, positioned for speed and efficiency in everyday coding and agentic workflows, below the frontier Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon models.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows. While our frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, excel at deep, long-horizon reasoning...

key_facts.fact: Hydrogen scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level, above Argon's 50, and 54 at its xhigh setting.
key_facts.excerpt: Hydrogen surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level (51 vs. 50, and reaching 54 at its highest xhigh thinking setting)

key_facts.fact: API pricing is flat across the full 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced flat across its entire 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.

key_facts.fact: Versus Gemini 3.8 Flash, which it replaces, Google says Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5 times faster, more than triples Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores (57% vs. 18.2%) and cuts fabricated claims by more than 5x.
key_facts.excerpt: Hydrogen finishes "tasks 2.5 times faster at its high default setting" ... "more than [triples] Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores (57% vs. 18.2%)" ... Cuts "fabricated claims by more than 5x"

key_facts.fact: It rolls out to all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Google Search, and to paid AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity; free Gemini app users get it via auto model selection.
key_facts.excerpt: for all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Google Search, and paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity... free users will get access to Gemini 4 Hydrogen via auto model selection

key_facts.fact: Google moved all Search users onto Hydrogen the same day, calling it the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.
key_facts.excerpt: Google rolled it out to Search users globally on the same day and calls it the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.

key_facts.fact: Hydrogen offers four configurable thinking levels and can run standalone or alongside Carbon and Argon.
key_facts.excerpt: running standalone across four configurable thinking levels or alongside frontier models like Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon

stories.headline: Global Microsoft 365 outage knocks out Outlook, Teams calendars and Copilot for nearly a day

key_facts.fact: A widespread outage hit Microsoft 365 starting after midday Eastern time on Thursday, November 12, continuing into the night and hitting companies and some government operations; nearly 130,000 users reported problems on Downdetector.
key_facts.excerpt: The disruptions, which were first reported after midday Eastern time and continued into the night, were also impacting many companies and some government operations. Nearly 130,000 users on outage tracker Downdetector reported problems

key_facts.fact: ThousandEyes observed the availability issues beginning around 17:30 UTC, with connection resets, timeouts, HTTP server errors and significant packet loss inside Microsoft's network.
key_facts.excerpt: Beginning around 17:30 UTC, ThousandEyes observed availability issues affecting Microsoft 365 services globally... connection resets, connection refusals, response timeouts, and HTTP server errors. Significant traffic loss in Microsoft's network was also observed

key_facts.fact: Microsoft said the outage affected 365 features that interact with Exchange Online, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Copilot and other business services, and initially blamed infrastructure under elevated load across multiple regions.
key_facts.excerpt: the outage is impacting Microsoft 365 features that interact with Exchange Online and email services, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Copilot AI, and other 365 business services... "a portion of infrastructure is experiencing elevated load across multiple regions"

key_facts.fact: Microsoft said a core process on the affected servers was becoming overwhelmed, causing servers to stop responding, and that its initial fixes had not provided the anticipated relief.
key_facts.excerpt: "our actions taken thus far have not provided the anticipated relief"... "a core process on the affected servers is becoming overwhelmed, which causes the servers to stop responding and contributes to the capacity loss."

key_facts.fact: To preserve delayed mail, Microsoft extended the email timeout to 48 hours.
key_facts.excerpt: To help preserve delayed mail during this event, we've extended email timeout to 48 hours.

key_facts.fact: By Friday morning (9:09am ET, November 13) Microsoft reported continued recovery in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific, while warning of intermittent access issues and delayed email.
key_facts.excerpt: Update, Nov 13, 9:09am ET: "We're seeing continued recovery progress across affected regions, with broader improvements in North America, sustained improvements across much of Europe, and encouraging recovery signals in Asia Pacific"

key_facts.fact: As of 14:00 UTC on November 13, ThousandEyes said Outlook availability had largely recovered, though loss and timeouts persisted in some locations.
key_facts.excerpt: As of 14:00 UTC on November 13, ThousandEyes observed that Microsoft Outlook availability has largely recovered... significant loss and connection timeouts persist for some locations.

stories.headline: Anthropic's automated red-teamer Anvil beats human experts at jailbreaking its safeguards

key_facts.fact: Anthropic published on November 12 its work on Anvil, an automated red-teaming system that outperforms human red-teamers against its bioweapons, cybersecurity and distillation safeguards.
key_facts.excerpt: we built Anvil, an automated red-teaming system, which outperforms human red-teamers against our bioweapons, cybersecurity, and distillation safeguards.

key_facts.fact: In biology, Anvil finds stronger jailbreaks than all human red-teamers in Anthropic's bug bounty program combined, in 24-48 hours rather than weeks to months.
key_facts.excerpt: In biology, in particular, Anvil finds stronger jailbreaks than all human red-teamers in our bug bounty program combined... finds these jailbreaks in 24–48 hours rather than weeks to months.

key_facts.fact: On cyber tasks, Anvil got a safeguarded model to write working exploits of known historical vulnerabilities in Chrome and Firefox JavaScript engines, breaking every task in 0.4-4.4 hours where expert red-teamers took up to 177 hours.
key_facts.excerpt: Anvil gets our safeguarded model to write full working exploits of known historical vulnerabilities in the JavaScript engines of Chrome and Firefox... in 0.4–4.4 hours each, where the experts took up to 177 wall-clock hours and broke fewer instances.

key_facts.fact: Against anti-distillation classifiers, Anvil reached its first substantial reasoning leak after 435 requests (1.2 hours) versus 102,200 requests (27.9 hours) for expert red-teamers.
key_facts.excerpt: Anvil reached its first substantial reasoning leak after 435 requests (1.2 hours), compared to the 102,200 requests (27.9 hours) that it took expert red-teamers

key_facts.fact: Anvil runs on frontier internal versions of Claude with safeguards disabled; Anthropic warns its performance scales with model strength, so attackers could soon build similar systems on models with weaker safeguards.
key_facts.excerpt: It relies on frontier internal versions of Claude with safeguards disabled... Anvil's performance improves with the strength of the model it runs on, suggesting that attackers could soon build similar systems on models with weaker safeguards.

key_facts.fact: The work meets a Responsible Scaling Policy goal of finding vulnerabilities in its safeguards better than expert human red-teamers; Anthropic now uses Anvil to vet new safeguards before deployment.
key_facts.excerpt: In our Responsible Scaling Policy, we set a goal that we would be able to find vulnerabilities in our safeguards better than expert human red-teamers... Today, we use Anvil to vet the robustness of new safeguards before we deploy them

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory, AI agents that pentest apps and patch flaws

key_facts.fact: OpenAI announced Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory at its Cyber at the Frontier event on November 12.
key_facts.excerpt: The products, Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory, were announced at the company's Cyber at the Frontier event on November 12.

key_facts.fact: Red Team, in early access, uses multiple AI agents with source code and app context to investigate attack paths and confirm vulnerabilities in web applications, and can validate findings from scanners and bug bounties.
key_facts.excerpt: Daybreak Red Team uses multiple AI agents to identify and investigate potential security weaknesses in web applications... can examine findings from code scanners, bug bounty submissions, and vulnerability disclosure reports.

key_facts.fact: Defense Factory automates finding, validating and fixing vulnerabilities using agents built on OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber model; engineers review proposed patches before merge.
key_facts.excerpt: Daybreak Defense Factory, automates the "defensive loop" by "finding, validating, and fixing vulnerabilities at scale." This one also uses agents built on OpenAI's latest cyber models - currently, that's GPT-6 Cyber.

key_facts.fact: Defense Factory imports findings from Wiz, Snyk and Endor Labs, scans connected GitHub repos and is offered as a preview plugin in ChatGPT; patches are not deployed automatically.
key_facts.excerpt: supports importing vulnerability information from Wiz, Snyk, and Endor Labs... Defense Factory is offered through a preview plugin in ChatGPT for workspaces with Daybreak access.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI President Greg Brockman said companies will be secure only to the extent of the frontier model they use to defend themselves.
key_facts.excerpt: "We're now at a point where companies will be secure only to the extent of the frontier model that they use to defend themselves and how well they utilize that," OpenAI President Greg Brockman said during a Thursday keynote address.

key_facts.fact: The launch follows GPT-6 Cyber, released the week before, which OpenAI says discovered nearly 1,000 vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.
key_facts.excerpt: Just last week, OpenAI also released GPT-6 Cyber, its most capable cybersecurity model, which discovered nearly 1,000 vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO, Harvey Jones board chair

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's board announced on November 12, 2026 that Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress agreed to serve as interim CEO while remaining CFO.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately. Colette Kress... has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer.

key_facts.fact: Harvey C. Jones was appointed the first-ever Chair of Nvidia's board, and the board is searching for a permanent CEO among internal and external candidates.
key_facts.excerpt: Harvey C. Jones Appointed First-Ever Chair of the Board... The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates.

key_facts.fact: Per Nvidia's 8-K filing, the board accepted Huang's resignation on November 11, 2026; Kress, 59, has been CFO since 2013.
key_facts.excerpt: On November 11, 2026, the Board of Directors... accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang... the Board appointed NVIDIA's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress, age 59, to serve as interim Chief Executive Officer

key_facts.fact: Huang stepped down days after admitting to an affair with a woman US authorities suspect of being a Chinese spy, an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed.
key_facts.excerpt: just a few days after he admitted to a romantic affair with an alleged Chinese spy, sparking a U.S. national security crisis.

key_facts.fact: In her first staff email, Kress called it 'an extraordinarily difficult period' and set a company meeting for November 18 at 9am PT.
key_facts.excerpt: The Board, Estaff and I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period... we will host a company meeting on November 18 at 9am PT.

key_facts.fact: President Trump posted on Truth Social that Apple executive chairman Tim Cook is the 'only one man' to replace Huang: 'A Legend replaces a Legend!'
key_facts.excerpt: In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that "only one man" could take Huang's place: Tim Cook of Apple. "A Legend replaces a Legend!" he wrote.

key_facts.fact: Trump said on Stephen A. Smith's podcast that Huang called him and is 'going through hell', and that Huang should have stepped down only if the woman was a spy, which he said has not been determined.
key_facts.excerpt: the big thing is, was the woman a spy, and I don't know if that's been determined yet... I spoke to him yesterday. He's going through hell.

stories.headline: Putin agrees to let Europe join next Ukraine talks round; envoys brief Zelensky in Dublin

key_facts.fact: After meeting Putin in the Kremlin on Nov. 12, US envoy Steve Witkoff said Europeans will join the next round of Ukraine peace talks, a step Reuters called a breakthrough.
key_facts.excerpt: "The Europeans will join at the next meeting, which we consider to be a very important moment because they are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin.

key_facts.fact: Putin warned that the European idea of sending Western troops into Ukraine after a peace deal would trigger a resumption of the war.
key_facts.excerpt: He then warned that the European idea of sending Western troops into Ukraine once a peace deal was concluded would trigger a resumption of the war because Russia would see that as a threat to its own security.

key_facts.fact: Putin proposed a joint Russian-Ukrainian humanitarian mission to Kostiantynivka; the Kremlin said the US side supported it and that Putin would continue Ukraine discussions with Trump at the APEC summit in China.
key_facts.excerpt: Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said Putin would continue discussions on Ukraine with U.S. President Donald Trump at an APEC summit in China later this month... the American side had supported Putin's proposal for a joint humanitarian mission

key_facts.fact: Witkoff and Kushner then met Zelensky the evening of Nov. 12 at Casement Aerodrome near Dublin; Zelensky said Europe will have a negotiating team 'at the table' next time and the coming prisoner swap will be the biggest of the war.
key_facts.excerpt: "Next time, next meeting, Europe...will be in the negotiating team," he said... "It will be the biggest, Steve and Jared told me, the biggest exchange of war prisoners yet," Zelensky said.

key_facts.fact: Kushner said Putin agreed to allow Europe to participate in negotiations: 'he's willing to give it a try.'
key_facts.excerpt: The envoy confirmed that Putin agreed to allow Europe to participate in negotiations regarding ending the war in Ukraine. "(H)e's willing to give it a try," Kushner said.

key_facts.fact: Territory remains unresolved: Russia holds about one fifth of Ukraine and Kyiv refuses to give up the rest of the Donbas.
